blocks.x: Was it for you mainly to play music or to have success with music?
No, no, it was the joy of this music and playing music. And it was just a pleasure to play music, as we heard it on the plates.
But it was also a little bit of a thing to bring.
First of all, you had to be the instrument to be the instrument and to make it with this style and to make it with this style, so that you could play in this direction.

Well, I don't have any engagements in Berlin in this sense. I practice at home. And I have to play in the summer now Straßenparades with a English cappella, the... a guest with a guest in Berlin in two weeks.
What kind of cappella was that?

Keith Smith and his Climax Chance Band from London. With his name I also very well known. And... They had now also a tourney with Elton Purnell in England. And Keith Smith, the 15th and 16th March here in New Orleans. He played in California with Elton Purnell's band as exchange. While he had the Daniel Rueber geholt, he played with his cappella in California in two weeks. And then he will come back here.
